name: Pocket Piggies
description: Read the account owner's PocketPiggies finances, read-only, in their own thread in the Steward AI app

ownerHouseholdPersonId.description: The owner's person id in the household app channel, whose own thread there, started from a message the owner's phone signed, may read finance. The key holder names the same owner.

ownerTelegramId.description: The Telegram chat a grant made before Telegram was retired is bound to. Only the key holder uses it; the plugin keeps it so that config still validates.
